text:
Alex G.: heads-up — we have a small visiting group (6 ppl) showing up at 10:30am for a quick 20m sync. they asked if we can do a pop-up coffee cart in the lobby and have temp badges ready. also one crate (48x30x20) on a pallet arriving at 9:45am that needs short-term staging. 
Sarah (People Ops): thanks! do we have capacity for the cart? iirc facilities needs 24h notice for outside vendors. :coffee:
Jon C.: facilities here — we can squeeze the cart if it's just countertop space. vendor needs a certificate of insurance though. who is the vendor?
Alex G.: vendor is "BeanRush Mobile" — i sent their COI to ops@ earlier today. i can forward again.
Sarah (People Ops): re: badges — can front desk print the temporary visitor lanyards? nothing fancy, just name + company. happy to drop a sheet at the desk.
Frontdesk Bot: Please upload the guest list to the "visitor-uploads" folder. Badge template: `visitor-temp-v3.pdf`. We can print up to 12 badges in 5 mins.
Riley F.: i can run over with the list at 9:55am. where should the crate go? north storage is full though.
Jon C.: crate can be staged by the loading dock on the pallet jack for an hour, then move to conference storage C if no one needs C. i'll reserve the cart and a dolly.
Sarah (People Ops): quick poll — who wants a seat in the lobby for the sync? we have 6 chairs + 1 couch. react with :hand: if you need a seat.
Alex G.: @Riley F. can you confirm the COI upload? i asked the vendor to email it to ops@ but just in case.
Riley F.: done — uploaded `BeanRush_COI_2026.pdf` to visitor-uploads at 9:12am. :white_check_mark:
Frontdesk Bot: Delivery incoming notice: oversized package for "Alex G." scheduled 9:45am. Courier: FedEx Ground. Please ensure someone is at the dock to accept.
Jon C.: i'll be there to accept and tag it. reminder: label crate with `temporary-staging-AlexG-3098765432`.
Sarah (People Ops): thanks all. i'll print the badges at 10:10 and leave them in the lobby tray. Alex — can you introduce the visitors at 10:30 so front desk can release badges?
Alex G.: yep, i'll meet them at the lobby and sign them in. also, can we request the coffee cart to serve decaf + oat milk? one guest mentioned dairy allergy.
Riley F.: noted. vendor confirmed dietary options in the COI email.
Sarah (People Ops): closing checklist for anyone jumping in later: 1) COI uploaded, 2) badges printed `visitor-temp-v3.pdf`, 3) crate staged at loading dock, 4) dolly reserved, 5) cart vendor COI verified, 6) lobby seating arranged. ping me if anything changes. :clipboard:
Alex G.: awesome — see you all at 10:30. :wave:
